en.title: Mainland China Weather Warning: Stay, Move or Rebook?
en.headline: A Weather Alert Is a Safety Signal, Not an Automatic Cancellation
en.description: For mainland China: decode an official weather warning, protect yourself, verify each booking state, and recover the trip without guessing.
en.heroAlt: Editorial diagram linking a weather alert to safety, booking verification, and a documented recovery route.
